Title: Azure Redis Cache: Preview of import/export and scale to Premium tier

Body.Content:
The Azure Redis Cache team is pleased to announce the following updates:

  • You can use the import/export data-management operation to import data into Azure Redis Cache or export data from Azure Redis Cache. For more information and a step-by-step guide, see Import and export data in Azure Redis Cache.
  • You can scale to the Premium tier. For more information and a step-by-step guide, see How to scale Azure Redis Cache.
Body.Markdown:
The Azure Redis Cache team is pleased to announce the following updates:

You can use the import/export data-management operation to import data into Azure Redis Cache or export data from Azure Redis Cache. For more information and a step-by-step guide, see Import and export data in Azure Redis Cache .

You can scale to the Premium tier. For more information and a step-by-step guide, see How to scale Azure Redis Cache .
